about: docs/protocol.md -> Extensions -> the share.ask extension. Whether the phone may make an ORDINARY share offer (one a person chose in the Android share sheet), given the extensions negotiated on the live session. Read by the phone's ShareIntakeTest and the Mac's shareActivation.test.ts. `negotiated` null means no live session. `send` is true only when share.file is negotiated at 2 or more AND share.ask at 1 or more.

cases.why: version 1 with ask: ask means nothing without the transfer
version 2 without ask: the synthetic-only development receiver
version 2 and ask: the production pairing (no Mac build advertises it yet)
a future version above both still sends
